compare_rule: per element: abs(a - b) <= atol + rtol * abs(b); a is the kernel output, b is the golden; comparison happens in the golden dtype (float32 for all C1 tasks); any element failing, any NaN in a or b, or dtype/element-count mismatch between a and b fails the kernel; max/mean error and norms are not used; a and b must not be swapped
rationale: f32 组合链（sigmoid/tanh/gelu-tanh/mish 由 exp/ln/div/mul 等基础指令组合，最长 13 条）的累积舍入约 1e-6~1e-5 相对量级，golden 是 torch 参考实现的单条超越函数；atol=1e-5、rtol=1e-4 覆盖该量级且不吞真实错误（board_3510 经验：同类指令对 golden 的偏差 <=1.19e-7，div/exp 类 <=6e-8）
